blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Arellano remained undefeated in Group B of the NCAA Season 102 men’s basketball tournament after routing Perpetual Help, 88-65, at Philsports Arena on Friday. The Chiefs improved to 3-0 after taking control early and never looking back. “Us coaches, we just helped these kids and they improved,” said coach Chico Manabat in Filipino. “Our preparations are just paying off. We prepared to win and we did just that. We stayed consistent.” READ: NCAA: T-Mc Ongotan continues strong showing for Arellano Arellano opened the game with a commanding 18-9 run before taking a 31-15 lead after the first quarter.
